label: Bible Study
prompt: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of _____, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verse: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
note: Paul links Genesis 1 to conversion — the God who said 'Let there be light' does it again in hearts.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy _____.
verse: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
note: God blots out transgressions 'for mine own sake' — and then chooses not to remember them.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his _____ and upward he was higher than any of the people.
verse: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
note: Saul looked the part: from his shoulders upward he was taller than anyone in Israel.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be _____ to me a sinner.
verse: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
note: The tax collector's seven-word prayer went home justified; the Pharisee's speech about himself didn't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall _____ all my will.
verse: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
note: Paul quoting God on David: 'a man after mine own heart' — and the KJV spells fulfil with just one l.
